name: aicad-agent
description: Agent-native 2D/3D engineering review across mechanical, electronics, packaging, architecture, civil, and steel/structural workflows, with hash-closed mechanical and PCB manufacturing candidates.

interface.shortDescription: Review and modify constrained 2D/3D CAD through one agent-native workflow.
interface.longDescription: Select geometry or parameters, read exact model measurements, toggle MODEL_XYZ, describe changes in plain language, inspect arbitrary sections, and submit one source-bound modification request back to the agent. The handoff is schema-validated, source-hash checked, previewed, applied, audited, and regenerated as a corrected selectable modifier before any artifact is written. One entry point covers system contracts plus mechanical, electronics, packaging, architecture, civil and steel/structural review with explicit maturity gates: civil and steel/structural outputs remain source-bound diagnostic or review candidates, never production-grade automatic design. Review HTML can be persisted by content hash without opening a tab; automated tools open tabs only for explicit auto/always requests. Protocol-4 native dimensions, exact transactions, dependency replay, host authority boundaries, production gates and audit evidence remain enforced internally.
capabilities: Cross-domain system interface, evidence and change-impact QA
Unified mechanical, electronics, packaging, architecture, civil and steel/structural entry point
Maturity-gated civil and steel/structural diagnostic review candidates
Dual-viewport forward annotation and semantic pick QA
Automatic post-build review launch with safe headless fallback
Construction-stage axis, sheet and furniture component gates
Precompile architectural axes, room equipment, dimension-purpose and door-topology contract
Protocol-4 native DIMENSION with purpose/style XData
SHA-bound design-basis and global axis-catalog freshness QA
Canonical mechanical and PCB evidence-contract QA
Per-PCB native, BOM, CPL, assembly, fabrication, PDF, 3D and CAM artifact closure
Hash-closed mechanical and PCB manufacturing release candidates
defaultPrompt: Open the CAD modifier so I can inspect and change exact model geometry.
